$comment: InDesign Data Merge oracle fixtures (docs/design/oracles.md). Geometry in points; bounds are InDesign geometricBounds [y1, x1, y2, x2]. A text frame's lines are paragraphs; <<field>> marks a Data Merge text placeholder (record.jsx turns each into a real placeholder). An image frame names its @field. record.sh builds each template in InDesign, saves it as templates/<id>.idml, merges csv/<id>.csv and writes recorded/<id>.json. data-conformance/tests/oracle.rs replays the recordings.

fixtures.what: one record per page: every record gets its own copy of the page
multiple records per page in one column with row spacing; spills to a second page
multiple records per page in a 2-column grid, rows first
57 unsorted records over several pages, 2 columns, columns first
Remove Blank Lines for Empty Fields: a line whose only content is an empty field disappears; an empty field after a label keeps its line
a record whose text does not fit its frame stays overset (Data Merge never grows the frame)
Data Merge inserts field text verbatim: en/de number text, leading zeros, signs and exponents are not reformatted
an @field image placeholder: each record's frame gets that record's image, fitted proportionally
